_note: Single source of truth for Intentional Empire visuals. Same palette as references/brand-kit.md. Edit here and every script and template follows.

colors._foundation: Midnight Navy is the page background (~75% of every page); Deep Sapphire for cards and panels
colors._text: Ivory headlines, Mist Blue body, Slate captions
colors._gold: Champagne for labels and highlights, Antique for italic accent words, Olive for rules, rings and line art
colors._blue: Royal for lines and strokes, Sky for accent labels, Cyan for data labels
colors._green: Emerald Mint for the GO verdict and success accents
colors._status: Alert Red: use once per piece at most, as a warning marker only

colorways._roles: bg=page, panel=card behind lists, text=headline, emphasis=*italic accent words*, label=eyebrow and list numbers, body=subhead and bullets, caption=footer, rule=frame, divider and line art

fonts._note: Fraunces and Arimo are the design fonts. Liberation Serif stands in for Fraunces and Liberation Sans for Arimo (metric twins, so layouts match). DejaVu Sans Mono sets the labels.
headline: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSerif-Bold.ttf
label: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf
